title: LLMLL Trust Report JSON Emit Schema
description: Shape of the JSON emitted by `llmll verify --trust-report --json`. Emit-only — the compiler never re-parses this artifact. Versioning is independent of the source JSON-AST schema (docs/llmll-ast.schema.json); the source `schemaVersion` and this `trust_report_version` track different surfaces. Consumers (e.g. the repair-loop harness) should pin to a major version of `trust_report_version`. Additive-only changes within a major version; breaking shape changes bump the major. v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3, v0.10.5) added parallel `tier_profile_pre` and `tier_profile_post` aggregates plus an optional `stale_downgrades` array, all additive over v1.0.0. v0.10.7 (OBLIG-PBT-5a) added the optional `joint_pbt_witnesses` array and the optional `joint_pbt_witness` per-entry flag for multi-subject PBT-Lift over-credit detection; no `trust_report_version` bump per the 2026-05-23 critique-triage routing. v1.2.0 (LT-CDP, v0.11) adds the optional `discriminative_axis` per-entry block carrying the contract-discriminative-power score, candidate counts, distinguishing inputs, spec-entropy annotation, and typed warning enumeration per `contract-discriminative-power-proposal.md` §5. The field is populated under `--cdp`; without `--cdp` a single `not-requested` warning is emitted so consumers see a uniform shape. Additive over v1.1.0 — existing consumers ignore the new block. LT-PPR (v0.11) adds six optional per-entry fields under `$defs/TrustEntry` when a predicate-carrying `?proof-required` is present: `pre_predicate_form`, `pre_predicate_text`, `pre_runtime_check_emitted`, and `post_*` equivalents. `trust_report_version` stays "1.2.0"; these fields are strictly additive over the LT-CDP v1.2.0 surface.

trust_report_version.description: Trust-report emit schema version. Independent of the source-program `schemaVersion` field on JSON-AST inputs.

entries.description: Per-function trust entries. One entry per def-logic / letrec across the entry module and the imported module cache.

summary.description: Pre-existing six-Int counts plus a drift total. Predates v0.10.4. Preserved unchanged; the new `tier_profile` aggregate sits alongside, not replacing.

tier_profile.description: v0.10.4 (R6d) — fixed-arity six-Int tier-count aggregate over per-function effective tier classifications. Never reduced to a scalar (LLMLL.md §4.4.1:344 declares contract_checked ‖ tested incomparable; the load-bearing diamond is preserved by refusing total order). Classification uses the diamond meet of pre and post per entry: a function with pre=contract_checked and post=tested has effective level `asserted` and increments only `asserted`, not both `contract_checked` and `tested`.

tier_profile_pre.description: v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3) — per-pre-clause tier-count aggregate. Each entry contributes by its per-clause effective level (the pre-clause evidence record meeting the transitive-callee effective level). Distinct from the scalar `tier_profile` which uses the per-function meet of pre and post. Optional in v1.1.0 to preserve back-compat for v1.0.0 strict-validation consumers; populated on every v1.1.0+ emit.

tier_profile_post.description: v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3) — per-post-clause tier-count aggregate. PBT-derived `tested` evidence is structurally post-only (the PBT-Lift rule at LLMLL.md §4.4.5 targets `csPost` only); downstream consumers reading the post-side empirical signal should consume this aggregate rather than the diamond-collapsed scalar `tier_profile`. Optional in v1.1.0 to preserve back-compat for v1.0.0 strict-validation consumers; populated on every v1.1.0+ emit.

stale_downgrades.description: v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3) — per-clause diagnostic strings for sidecar evidence records whose `pbt_witnesses` did not match any live property-body hash on read. Each downgrade reflects a `DLTested → DLAsserted` strict downgrade of a stale cached entry. Optional; empty array when no downgrades occurred.

suppressions.description: v0.6 weakness-ok declarations: (function name, reason). Acknowledges intentional contract gaps.

joint_pbt_witnesses.description: v0.10.7 (OBLIG-PBT-5a) — groupings of canonical-property-body witness hashes that appear on the post-clause evidence of two or more distinct subject names. Each group is the result of a `:subjects [f g …]` joint lift (OBLIG-PBT-4); the scalar `tested` counts in `summary` and the `tested` slot of `tier_profile` / `tier_profile_post` exclude joint-only credit so N subjects sharing one property body do not contribute N. Optional in the emit shape (always present in v0.10.7+ emits, may be empty); v1.1.0 consumers that did not request this key may safely ignore it. Strictly additive over v1.1.0 — no `trust_report_version` bump.

joint_pbt_witness.description: v0.10.7 (OBLIG-PBT-5a) — present and `true` iff this entry's post-clause evidence has non-empty `pbt_witnesses` AND every witness hash is shared with at least one other subject (i.e. originated from a `:subjects [...]` joint lift). The flag is omitted entirely when false to keep the emit minimal. Scalar `tested` counts (`summary.tested`, `tier_profile.tested`, `tier_profile_post.tested`) demote joint-only entries to `asserted` so the per-property body credit is not multiplied across N subjects. The raw post-side `EvidenceRecord` (incl. `pbt_witnesses` on `.verified.json`) is left intact for the clean OBLIG-PBT-5b post-freeze fix.

overflow_tainted.description: INT-1 (v0.10.8) — present and `true` iff any evidence record on this entry carries the `overflow_tainted` flag (body-faithful verified evidence whose body contains unbounded-Int arithmetic). Omitted when false. `--strict-verified-core` refuses tainted entries.

discriminative_axis.description: v1.2.0 (LT-CDP, v0.11) — optional per-function contract-discriminative-power measurement. Populated under `--cdp` per `contract-discriminative-power-proposal.md` §5. Without `--cdp`, the block populates with `score: null`, `basis: "not-measured"`, and a single `not-requested` warning so the shape is uniform. Additive over v1.1.0.

pre_predicate_form.description: LT-PPR (v0.11) — enforcement-mode label for the pre-clause predicate when a predicate-carrying ?proof-required is present. "runtime": predicate is enforced via a Haskell runtime assertion emitted at codegen (TrustReport.hs:320). "symbolic": reserved for a future solver-submission path; not emitted in v0.11. Omitted when the pre clause carries no predicate-carrying ?proof-required. Distinct from pre_predicate_text: this field is the mode label; that field is the expression text.

pre_predicate_text.description: LT-PPR (v0.11) — JSON-encoded serialization of the pre-clause predicate expression (exprToJson of the carried Expr payload in HProofRequired). Omitted when the pre clause carries no predicate-carrying ?proof-required. Distinct from pre_predicate_form: this field is the expression; that field is the enforcement-mode label.

pre_runtime_check_emitted.description: LT-PPR (v0.11) — present and true iff codegen emitted a Haskell runtime assertion for the pre-clause predicate-carrying ?proof-required (`if <pred> then () else error "proof-required: <reason>"`). Omitted when false. Trust tier stays asserted regardless; this flag records the presence of a codegen enforcement artifact (TrustReport.hs:811).

post_predicate_form.description: LT-PPR (v0.11) — enforcement-mode label for the post-clause predicate when a predicate-carrying ?proof-required is present. Semantics mirror pre_predicate_form. Omitted when the post clause carries no predicate-carrying ?proof-required.

post_predicate_text.description: LT-PPR (v0.11) — JSON-encoded serialization of the post-clause predicate expression. `result` is in scope in post-position per LLMLL.md §13.10. Semantics mirror pre_predicate_text. Omitted when the post clause carries no predicate-carrying ?proof-required.

post_runtime_check_emitted.description: LT-PPR (v0.11) — present and true iff codegen emitted a Haskell runtime assertion for the post-clause predicate-carrying ?proof-required. Semantics mirror pre_runtime_check_emitted (TrustReport.hs:812).

drifts.description: Total epistemic drift warnings across all entries. Not a tier — a violation count on the tier classification.

TierProfile.description: Six-Int aggregate of per-function effective tier classifications. Component-wise dominance is the only legitimate partial order; never total-ordered into a scalar.

verified.description: Functions whose effective level is `verified` (body-faithful SMT proof). See LLMLL.md §4.4.1.

proved.description: Reserved for a future Lean-discharged tier. Zero by construction in v1.0.0 emits — no DLProved constructor exists in the compiler's DisplayLevel ADT yet. Forward-compatible slot so the field shape is stable across future tier additions.

contract_checked.description: Functions whose effective level is `contract-checked` (SMT proof of pre⇒post consistency, body not encoded). Incomparable with `tested` per the diamond lattice (LLMLL.md §4.4.1:344).

tested.description: Functions whose effective level is `tested` (PBT passed N samples, no static proof). Incomparable with `contract_checked` per the diamond lattice.

asserted.description: Functions whose effective level is `asserted` (runtime assertion only). Includes the diamond meet `contract_checked ⊓ tested = asserted` when pre and post sit in incomparable branches.

no_contract.description: Functions with no contract clauses at all. Distinct from `asserted`, which has clauses but no static evidence.

JointPbtWitness.description: v0.10.7 (OBLIG-PBT-5a) — one canonical-property-body witness hash and the list of subject names whose post-clause evidence carries it. `subjects.length >= 2` by construction (a single-subject witness is not joint). Subjects are sorted ascending for deterministic emit.

LevelLabel.description: Human-readable level label as emitted by `dlLabel` (Syntax.hs). Examples: `"verified (liquid-fixpoint)"`, `"verified (lean)"`, `"contract-checked (z3)"`, `"tested (100 samples)"`, `"asserted"`. JSON `null` when the corresponding clause is absent.

DiscriminativeAxis.description: v1.2.0 (LT-CDP, v0.11) — Contract Discriminative Power measurement per function. See `docs/design/contract-discriminative-power-proposal.md` Rev 2 §4–§5 for the score formula, candidate-set enumeration, and warning taxonomy. The score is OBSERVATIONAL over the candidate set Ω identified by `basis`; cross-version comparisons require same-basis discipline.

score.description: Shannon-normalized DP_Ω(S) ∈ [0,1]. Higher is stronger. `null` when the score is undefined (proposal §4.1 edge cases: |⟦S⟧| = 0, |B| ≤ 1, or `--cdp` not requested).

basis.description: Source of the candidate set Ω. `"observational-candidate-set"` is the v0.11 closed enumeration per proposal §4.3.1. `"not-measured"` indicates `--cdp` was not requested. Future bases (v0.12+): `"llm-generated-candidates"`, `"mutation-based"`, `"external-corpus"`.

candidate_count.description: Total candidates from the §4.3.1 enumeration that type-checked.

satisfying_candidate_count.description: Candidates whose synthetic trivial body satisfied the contract (solver SAFE).

distinct_observed_behavior_count.description: Equivalence classes of satisfying candidates over the observation set Ω. Distinct from `satisfying_candidate_count` because multiple candidates may collapse to one observed behavior.

distinguishing_inputs.description: Candidate-body labels that distinguish satisfying behaviors from non-satisfying behaviors. At most 4 entries in v0.11; surfaced for downstream `--weakness-check`-derived diagnostics.

spec_entropy_annotation.description: Echo of the source `(spec-entropy ...)` annotation. `"strict"` is the default for unannotated contracts.

warnings.description: Typed warning enumeration per proposal §5. Multiple warnings may co-occur. Distinguishes non-applicability (`def-shell-out-of-scope`, `not-requested`) from measurement weakness (`enumeration-too-narrow`, `candidates-empty-under-limit`).
